cases.sentence: Тут есть ___, у которого пять ячменных хлебов и две рыбки, но разве этого хватит на всех?
cases.translation: There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what good are these for so many?
cases.explain: Мальчик is the grammatical subject of «есть» (there is), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Если купить ___ и на двести динариев, то этого не хватит, даже чтобы раздать каждому по кусочку.
cases.translation: Even if we bought two hundred denarii worth of bread, it would not be enough for everyone to have even a little piece.
cases.explain: The verb купить (to buy) takes a partitive genitive object here — хлеба means "some bread," not a definite whole.

cases.sentence: Когда наступил вечер, ученики Иисуса спустились к ___ и, сев в лодку, поплыли через озеро в Капернаум.
cases.translation: When evening came, Jesus's disciples went down to the lake and, getting into a boat, sailed across the lake to Capernaum.
cases.explain: The preposition к always governs the dative case, hence озеру.

cases.sentence: Иисус понял, что они хотят насильно поставить его царем, и поэтому снова ушел на ___ один.
cases.translation: Jesus realized they wanted to make him king by force, so he withdrew again to the mountain alone.
cases.explain: The preposition на combined with a verb of motion (ушел, "went off") governs the accusative case, hence гору.

cases.sentence: То же самое он сделал и с ___.
cases.translation: He did the same with the fish.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "with" governs the instrumental case, hence рыбой.

cases.sentence: Иисус сказал это, когда учил в синагоге в ___.
cases.translation: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing location (not motion) governs the prepositional case, hence Капернауме.

reading.ru: После этого Иисус переправился на другую сторону Галилейского, или, как его еще называют, Тибериадского озера.
reading.question: Where did Jesus go at the start of this account?
options: To the other side of the Sea of Galilee (also called the Sea of Tiberias)
reading.correct: To the other side of the Sea of Galilee (also called the Sea of Tiberias)
reading.explain: The text says Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, also called the Sea of Tiberias.

reading.ru: Тут есть мальчик, у которого пять ячменных хлебов и две рыбки, но разве этого хватит на всех?
reading.question: What did the boy have, according to Andrew?
options: Five barley loaves and two fish
Two barley loaves and five fish
Five fish and two loaves of wheat bread
reading.correct: Five barley loaves and two fish
reading.explain: Andrew tells Jesus the boy has five barley loaves and two small fish.

reading.ru: Они собрали и наполнили двенадцать корзин тем, что осталось у тех, кто ел от пяти чменных хлебов.
reading.question: How many baskets of leftovers did the disciples gather?
reading.explain: The text says they gathered and filled twelve baskets with the leftover pieces.

reading.ru: Проплыв около двадцати пяти или тридцати стадий, они увидели Иисуса, идущего по воде и приближающегося к лодке.
reading.question: What did the disciples see after rowing about twenty-five or thirty stadia?
options: Jesus walking on the water, approaching the boat
A great storm destroying their boat
An angel standing on the shore
reading.correct: Jesus walking on the water, approaching the boat
reading.explain: After rowing that distance, they saw Jesus walking on the water and approaching the boat.

reading.ru: Они хотели взять его в лодку, и лодка в тот же момент оказалась уже у берега, к которому они плыли.
reading.question: What happened right after the disciples were willing to take Jesus into the boat?
options: The boat was immediately at the shore they were heading to
The boat capsized in the storm
Jesus refused to enter the boat
reading.correct: The boat was immediately at the shore they were heading to
reading.explain: The text says the boat immediately reached the shore they were sailing toward.

reading.ru: На следующий день народ, оставшийся на противоположном берегу озера, вспомнил, что там была только одна лодка.
reading.question: What did the crowd remember on the next day?
options: That there had been only one boat
That Jesus had already left for Jerusalem
That the disciples had taken all the bread
That a storm had sunk the boat
reading.correct: That there had been only one boat
reading.explain: The crowd recalled that there had only been one boat there the day before.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, «Говорю вам истину, вы ищете меня не потому, что видели знамение, а потому что ели хлеб и наелись досыта.
reading.question: Why does Jesus say the crowd is seeking him?
options: Because they ate the bread and were filled, not because they saw signs
Because they wanted to make him king
Because they wanted to hear him teach in the synagogue
reading.correct: Because they ate the bread and were filled, not because they saw signs
reading.explain: Jesus tells them they seek him because they ate bread and were filled, not because they understood the sign.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал им, «Говорю вам истину, это не Моисей дал вам хлеб с небес, а Мой Отец дает вам истинный хлеб с небес, потому что хлеб Божий — это Тот, Кто приходит с небес и дает миру жизнь».
reading.question: According to Jesus, who truly gave the bread from heaven?
reading.explain: Jesus corrects them that it was his Father, not Moses, who gives the true bread from heaven.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал, Я сам и есть хлеб жизни, кто приходит ко мне, тот никогда не останется голодным, и кто верит мне, тот не будет испытывать жажды.
reading.question: What does Jesus claim about himself in this statement?
options: He is the bread of life; those who come to him will never be hungry
He is the true vine; those who abide in him will bear fruit
He is the good shepherd who lays down his life
He is greater than the temple
reading.correct: He is the bread of life; those who come to him will never be hungry
reading.explain: Jesus declares himself the bread of life, saying whoever comes to him will never be hungry.

reading.ru: Бывших там иудеев разозлило то, что Иисус сказал «Я хлеб, пришедший с небес».
reading.question: Why were the Jews present angered?
options: Because Jesus said he was the bread that came down from heaven
Because Jesus healed on the Sabbath
Because Jesus overturned tables in the temple
Because Jesus refused to pay taxes
reading.correct: Because Jesus said he was the bread that came down from heaven
reading.explain: The Jews were upset because Jesus claimed to be the bread that came down from heaven.

reading.ru: Они говорили «Разве он не Иисус, сын Иосифа? Мы же знаем и отца его, и мать.
reading.question: What objection did the Jews raise about Jesus's claim?
options: That he was just Joseph's son, whose parents they knew
That he had never performed any signs
That he was not born in Bethlehem
reading.correct: That he was just Joseph's son, whose parents they knew
reading.explain: The Jews object that Jesus is merely the son of Joseph, whose parents they know.

reading.ru: Ваши праотцы ели манну в пустыне и все же умерли.
reading.question: What does Jesus say happened to the ancestors who ate manna in the wilderness?
reading.explain: Jesus points out that even though their ancestors ate manna, they still died.

reading.ru: Этот хлеб — тело мое, которое я отдаю ради жизни мира.
reading.question: What does Jesus identify the bread as?
options: His flesh, given for the life of the world
A symbol of the Passover lamb
reading.correct: His flesh, given for the life of the world
reading.explain: Jesus states that the bread is his flesh, given for the life of the world.

reading.ru: Многие из его учеников, услышав это, говорили... Это какое-то непонятное учение, и кто только может его слушать?
reading.question: How did many of Jesus's disciples react to his teaching?
options: They called it a hard, incomprehensible teaching that was difficult to accept
They immediately understood and praised him
They asked him to repeat it in parables
They reported him to the Pharisees
reading.correct: They called it a hard, incomprehensible teaching that was difficult to accept
reading.explain: Many disciples called his teaching hard to understand and questioned who could accept it.

reading.ru: Тогда многие из его учеников оставили его и больше не ходили с ним.
reading.question: What did many disciples do after this teaching?
options: They left him and no longer walked with him
They followed him even more closely
They asked him to explain the parable of the sower
They went to tell the Pharisees
reading.correct: They left him and no longer walked with him
reading.explain: The text says many disciples turned away and stopped following Jesus.

reading.ru: Симон Петр ответил. «Господи, кому нам еще идти? У тебя слова вечной жизни.
reading.question: How did Simon Peter respond when Jesus asked if the twelve wanted to leave too?
options: He said there was nowhere else to go, since Jesus has the words of eternal life
He said he would return to fishing
He asked Jesus to perform another miracle
reading.correct: He said there was nowhere else to go, since Jesus has the words of eternal life
reading.explain: Peter answers that they have nowhere else to go because Jesus has the words of eternal life.
